description: Emplacements PMR - Databusters is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by FuturoCité. Ce jeu de données présente différentes places de parking pour personne à mobilité réduite à Wallonie Motivations pour la création du jeu de données Ce jeu de données est issu d’un exercice de Crowdsourcing réalisé par FuturoCité du 10 au 31 octobre 2022, sous forme de challenge (“Emplacements PMR - Si tu prends ma place ... Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobilité, Urbanisme, Patrimoine. Its keywords are pmr, personne, mobilité, réduire, handicap, handicapé. The portal shows 117 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-02-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
